title: Being said 'because he's here'
place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: He said because he's here. And they didn't say didn't say my name, didn't say his name, just said because he's here.

plain: During an encounter in 1977 in the missile field of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, a being said something was happening "because he's here," according to an Air Force veteran named Mario Woods, who says he was abducted by aliens there. Woods, who was present, recalls that it named no one, neither him nor the other man with him: it "just said because he's here."
